name: impact-simple386-rejected-row-first
description: Trace-derived control profile that returns the row rejected in the SIMPLE386 run as the first analysis result. Use to test whether IMPACT rejects this row because of values/format or only after accumulated state.

responses.label: impact-rejected-row-as-first-result
responses.control_question: If IMPACT rejects this as the first row, suspect row value/range/format. If it accepts it first but rejects it after three prior rows, suspect accumulated IMPACT state.

responses.label: impact-accepted-end-marker
responses.note: No response is needed; only record whether IMPACT sends #em. Updated to ACK #em with # because real traces show ARL acknowledgement after accepted/end-marker transitions.

responses.label: impact-generic-setup-st-ack
responses.note: Fallback for trace-derived emulator profiles: IMPACT can resend unprefixed st setup rows after storing/canceling a sample. The real ARL acknowledges these rows with #0 080.

responses.label: impact-generic-setup-hash-st-ack
responses.note: Fallback for trace-derived emulator profiles: preserve exact replay when available, but acknowledge unseen #st setup rows instead of hanging.

responses.label: impact-generic-new-sample-ns-ack
responses.note: Fallback for trace-derived emulator profiles: after Store Result/cancel, IMPACT can send unprefixed ns rows before another analysis. Real traces show ns/#ns transitions acknowledged with #.

responses.label: impact-generic-new-sample-hash-ns-ack
responses.note: Fallback for trace-derived emulator profiles: acknowledge unseen #ns new-sample rows instead of hanging.
